Profit = (Price - Variable Cost) * Units Sold - Fixed Cost
Units Sold = min(Demand, Capacity 2000)

Variable cost = $9, Fixed = $12,000.00.
All demands < 2000, so Units Sold = Demand. No capacity truncation.
No exponential factors to approximate; carry exact integers through.

Calculations:

- $19, 498 units: margin 19-9=10. 498*10=4980. 4980-12000 = -7020
- $24, 1357 units: margin 24-9=15. 1357*15=20355. 20355-12000 = 8355
- $29, 775 units: margin 29-9=20. 775*20=15500. 15500-12000 = 3500
- $34, 149 units: margin 34-9=25. 149*25=3725. 3725-12000 = -8275
- $39, 118 units: margin 39-9=30. 118*30=3540. 3540-12000 = -8460

Cross-check in reverse order Revenue - (Fixed + Variable*Qty):
- 19*498=9462 - (12000+4482=16482) = -7020
- 24*1357=32568 - (12000+12213=24213) = 8355
- 29*775=22475 - (12000+6975=18975) = 3500
- 34*149=5066 - (12000+1341=13341) = -8275
- 39*118=4602 - (12000+1062=13062) = -8460

Matches. Maximum is $24 with $8,355 profit.
